data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx2.pcsx2_fastboot.Help
data.value: Skips the BIOS startup screen and starts the game directly. Disable this to open the console settings or the memory card manager.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_fast_memory.Help
data.value: Enable faster memory access. This may make some games unstable.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_force_lag_sync.Help
data.value: Synchronize emulation with the real-time clock to reduce input lag. This may reduce performance.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_software_rendering.Help
data.value: Use software rendering for improved accuracy at a higher processing cost.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_cropto16x9.Help
data.value: Crop the top and bottom of the image to display a 16:9 picture.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_frame_duplication.Help
data.value: Duplicate video frames to improve motion smoothness in games with a low frame rate.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_detect_vsync_swap_interval.Help
data.value: Report changes in the game's video frame rate to the application.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_inflight_frames.Help
data.value: Reduce graphics command buffering to lower input delay. This may reduce performance. OpenGL and Vulkan only.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_inflight_frames.Value.1
data.value: Buffer up to one video frame

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_analog_is_circular.Label
data.value: Analog Circle vs Square Gate Compensation

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_analog_deadzone.Help
data.value: Apply an additional analog stick dead zone after the application's input processing.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_analog_sensitivity.Help
data.value: Apply additional analog stick sensitivity after the application's input processing.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_skip_buffer_effects.Help
data.value: Skip frame-buffer effects to improve performance. Some games may show no picture.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_skip_gpu_readbacks.Help
data.value: Skip copying graphics data from the GPU to the CPU. Some games need these copies to display correctly.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_lazy_texture_caching.Help
data.value: Faster, but can cause text problems in a few games.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_spline_quality.Help
data.value: Only used by some games, controls smoothness of curves.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_lower_resolution_for_effects.Help
data.value: Reduce the resolution of some visual effects to avoid rendering artifacts.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_software_skinning.Help
data.value: Process and combine animated 3D model drawing operations on the CPU. This improves performance in most games.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_hardware_tesselation.Help
data.value: Use the GPU to render smooth curves.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_texture_scaling_level.Help
data.value: Enlarging textures increases CPU usage. Some textures are enlarged later to avoid stuttering.

data.name: Emulation.Option.ppsspp.ppsspp_texture_deposterize.Help
data.value: Reduce visible bands of color in enlarged textures.
